authority: Current plugin-owned contract, exported mechanically; no second schema authority
scope: Source-backed physical locators, typed payload relationships and admission/recovery owner boundaries

committed_state.format: UTF-8 JSON under canonical lock + committed manifest generation; pending publication rejects
committed_state.public_policy: Complete value validates before exact sealed public projection; current catalog/policy pin checked before and after
committed_state.layout: No POSIX segment ABI, fixed offset or raw mapped address; owned decoded snapshot

captured_store.format: Captured TypedObject/ViewManifest/Workspace UTF-8 JSON with BLAKE3 content addresses; not OPBLOB01 plugin authority
captured_store.writer: Existing .lock + file sync/atomic rename/parent sync; workspace expected-object CAS

method_journal.owner: existing RuntimeDocuments durable private Cozo plugin_runtime_documents relation
method_journal.retention: Permanent authoritative reservation/tombstone; never a domain result cache; no automatic reuse after restart/retention
method_journal.payload: Bounded sanitized scope/schema provenance/status/attempt+terminal proof only; no raw private arguments or results; result_digest null
method_journal.mutation_order: CAS absent revision0 reserve -> confirmed durable attempt -> attempt journal CAS -> backend commit -> result validation -> terminal durable audit -> terminal journal CAS
method_journal.recovery: One receiver-scoped durable point read with persistence barrier; missing/foreign IDs do not reveal another caller's operation
